TORONTO, Sept. 21, 2026 /CNW/ -- 3iQ Corp. ("3iQ"), a global pioneer in digital asset investment solutions and issuer of the 3iQ Bitcoin ETF, 3iQ Ether Staking ETF, 3iQ Solana Staking ETF, and 3iQ XRP ETF (collectively, the "Funds"), today announced that, effective September 21, 2026, Anchorage Digital, home to America's first federally regulated digital asset bank, has been added as an additional sub-custodian under the Funds' multi-custody arrangement. Tetra Trust remains the Funds' primary custodian and has played an instrumental role in the integration of Anchorage Digital as part of the Funds' expanded custody framework.
The addition follows the previously announced

params.linkText: selection of Anchorage Digital as 3iQ's infrastructure and custody partner for its digital asset investment platform

children: , and is intended to provide the Funds with additional institutional digital asset custody infrastructure, operational flexibility, and security controls appropriate for a publicly listed digital asset investment fund.

There is no change to the Funds' investment objectives, investment strategy, management fee, ticker symbols, or listing on the Toronto Stock Exchange as a result of the addition of Anchorage Digital as an additional sub-custodian. Units of the Funds will continue to trade on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
Nathan McCauley, CEO and Co-Founder of Anchorage Digital, said:

"3iQ helped pioneer regulated digital asset investing, and we're proud to deepen our partnership by serving as a sub-custodian for its ETFs. Publicly listed funds demand institutional-grade security and operational rigor — that's exactly what Anchorage Digital was built to provide. We look forward to supporting 3iQ as it expands institutional access to digital assets."

Tommaso Mancuso, President and Chief Investment Officer of 3iQ, said: "Adding Anchorage Digital as an additional sub-custodian is an important operational milestone for the 3iQ ETFs. As digital asset investment products continue to mature, custody infrastructure remains central to investor protection, operational resilience, and long-term scalability. Anchorage Digital Bank, N.A. provides the regulated, institutional-grade infrastructure that aligns with the needs of the Funds and their unitholders."
3iQ will file a material change report in respect of the addition of Anchorage Digital as an additional sub-custodian to the Funds, which will be available under the Funds' profile on SEDAR+ at

Founded in 2012, 3iQ is one of the world's leading alternative digital asset managers, pioneering institutional-grade investments. 3iQ launched the world's first Digital Assets Managed Account Platform (QMAP), a hedge fund investment solution, offering innovative risk-managed investment solutions to gain exposure to digital assets. 3iQ was also the first to launch a Bitcoin and Ethereum ETP listed on a major global stock exchange, integrate staking into its Ethereum and Solana ETPs boosting investor returns, and offering other regulated ETPs. 3iQ is a subsidiary of Coincheck Group N.V(
), a NASDAQ-listed holding company based in the Netherlands. Since 2012, 3iQ has been at the forefront of innovation in digital asset investment management. To learn more about 3iQ, visit 3iq.io.

Anchorage Digital is the proven infrastructure layer for modern financial markets that gives institutions a single platform to participate in digital assets, including prime services, tokenization, stablecoins, and the governance framework for agentic finance. Home to Anchorage Digital Bank N.A., America's first federally regulated digital asset bank, Anchorage Digital also serves institutions through Anchorage Digital Singapore, licensed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore; Anchorage Digital NY, which holds a BitLicense from the New York Department of Financial Services; and self-custody wallet Porto by Anchorage Digital. Anchorage Digital Bank also offers fiat custody services through an FDIC-insured, licensed sub-custodian. Anchorage Digital is funded by leading institutions including Andreessen Horowitz, GIC, Goldman Sachs, KKR, and Visa, with a valuation of $4.2 billion. Founded in 2017 in San Francisco, California, Anchorage Digital has offices in New York, New York; Porto, Portugal; Singapore; and Sioux Falls, South Dakota. Learn more at
